Are you a technically strong and business‑oriented Machine Learning / AI Engineer with a passion for building and scaling intelligent solutions? Our team is looking for a hands‑on engineer with deep experience in AI/ML engineering and AI/ML engineering operations who can partner with clients to design, build, and operationalize AI‑powered solutions at scale.

This role will focus on translating advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases into secure, scalable, and production‑ready solutions across on-prem and cloud environments (ideally on Azure but also GCP and AWS).

What You Will Do


Partner with clients to understand business problems and identify opportunities to apply AI and advanced analytics solutions.
Translate business and analytical requirements into end‑to‑end ML/AI solution design,
Execute ML/AI engineering tasks including exploratory data analysis, data preparation, model development (e.g., forecasting, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection) using tech stack such as Python and common ML frameworks (e.g., scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure ML Studio, Databricks MLFlow).
Develop and optimize AI and GenAI solutions using state-of-the-art tools and platform (AI Foundry, GCP Vertex AI, AWS Sagemaker and Bedrock).
Operationalize AI/ML pipelines using AI/ML Ops best practices, including model deployment versioning, CI/CD, automated testing, and monitoring.
Implement model monitoring, performance tuning, drift detection, and retraining strategies in production environments.
Collaborate with data engineers to ensure reliable, scalable data pipelines that support model training and inference.
Apply responsible AI principles, including explainability, bias detection, model governance, and compliance with security and privacy standards.
Support client workshops, technical discussions, and stakeholder presentations related to AI strategy, solution design, and implementation.


What You Bring To The Role


University degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, or a related discipline.
3+ years of professional experience in machine learning, data science, AI engineering, or a related field, with demonstrated experience delivering production ML solutions.
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, machine learning, and model development.
Hands‑on experience with machine learning frameworks/libraries and platform tools (e.g., scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure ML Studio, Databricks MLFlow).
Solid understanding of ML algorithms, statistics, model evaluation techniques, and feature engineering.
Experience designing and implementing end‑to‑end ML pipelines, including data preprocessing, model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
Practical experience with ML Ops practices, including CI/CD, model versioning, experiment tracking, and automated retraining.
Experience deploying ML models to cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with an understanding of cloud‑native architecture and security principles.
Familiarity with big data or distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Spark) is an asset.
Experience with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) is essential, experience with fine-tuning foundational models is an asset.
Strong consulting and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to collaborate within cross‑functional and multi‑disciplinary teams to solve complex business problems.


Certifications (Preferred)


Cloud AI / ML certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate or better, AWS Machine Learning Specialty or better, Google Professional ML Engineer or better, Databricks ML Engineer Associate or better, Databricks Generative AI Engineer).

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA Sports FC Live
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst - FC Live Service Forecasting

Our FC Data & Analytics team is looking for an Advanced Analyst to join our group, leading forecasting and performance modelling for FC’s live service business. Reporting to a Senior Analytics Manager, you will be part of a growing team providing data and insights around player behaviour and live content performance within the FC franchise. We’re looking for someone who combines strong quantitative forecasting expertise with business intuition, bringing the ability to translate historical trends, player behaviour, and live content strategies into actionable projections that inform decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and live service operations - helping shape how FC plans and measures performance at scale.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Own the forecasting framework that underpins performance measurement, planning, and strategic decision-making across FC’s live service business.
Employ an extensive toolkit of financial modelling techniques, time series analysis, and a deep knowledge of their use cases.
Develop a robust model that projects our live service funnel metrics to a high degree of fidelity, incorporating player behaviour, in-game content, and macroeconomic trends.
Collaborate with partners across Product Management, Finance, and Commercial teams to align on projections, and keep the business updated on how our latest live service performance impacts our model’s assumptions.
Establish scalable forecasting processes that enable us to work with our cross-functional partners to efficiently & effectively refine our projections over time.
Lead presentations to diverse audiences including senior and executive level management, distilling complex model results into clear insights & recommendations.
Run risk and opportunity scenarios based on live content plans, new feature additions, and other potential changes in the FC product.
Mentor and collaborate with other analysts in order to collaboratively develop our forecasts, working together to drive evolutions in our modelling in this space.


What We're Looking For


A degree in a quantitative discipline (Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or similar)
7+ years of experience in a data-driven role performing quantitative analysis with big data to help guide decisions
4+ years of experience developing financial/product performance projections and forecasts using various modelling techniques
Strong experience in statistical and/or time series modelling for predictive purposes
Expertise in SQL and working with large-scale, complex datasets
Proficient in analyzing large datasets using programmatic tools (e.g. Python, R)
Experience with data visualization software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI)
Strong capabilities in project management processes
Very comfortable presenting analysis in an executive facing environment


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. Title: Quantitative Researcher
Description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Quantitative Researcher to join our dynamic team. This role involves developing and implementing quantitative models to identify trading opportunities in financial markets. The ideal candidate will possess strong research skills, a solid understanding of investment strategies, and expertise in risk analysis and mathematical modeling within the financial services sector. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to innovative trading strategies and advance your career in quantitative finance.

Duties


Conduct rigorous research to develop quantitative models for trading strategies across various asset classes
Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, trends, and potential investment opportunities
Design, backtest, and optimize algorithmic trading models to improve performance and manage risk effectively
Collaborate with team members to refine trading algorithms based on market conditions and new research findings
Monitor live trading systems, ensuring models operate efficiently and accurately in real-time environments
Stay informed on market developments, financial instruments, and emerging quantitative techniques to enhance trading strategies
Document research processes, model assumptions, and performance metrics for ongoing review and improvement



Experience


Proven experience in research within the financial services industry, particularly in investment banking or asset management
Strong background in finance, with a focus on investment strategies, risk analysis, and quantitative modeling
Proficiency in advanced mathematics, statistical analysis, and programming languages such as Python, R, or MATLAB
Familiarity with financial markets, instruments, and trading platforms is highly desirable
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets and develop innovative solutions for investment challenges
Prior experience in developing or implementing algorithmic trading systems is a plus



This role is ideal for individuals passionate about applying quantitative methods to finance, eager to contribute to cutting-edge trading strategies, and committed to continuous learning within a fast-paced environment.

This role is ideal for individuals proficient in applying ML methodologies and tools to a wide range of data and use cases.

The role is based in Toronto, Montreal or Vancouver. It is a hybrid role.

Our team is globally based, with key locations in Toronto, Montreal, San Francisco and Vancouver.

Review state-of the-art media-focused, and especially motion-focused ML publications and technologies
Assess capabilities for feasibility and generalizability, and report to project and program leads
Implement cutting edge ML results, improve existing models Stay current with new ML models and AI techniques
Develop new specific as well as generalized large models for motion prediction under various modalities
Develop end-to-end workflows, leveraging new data-driven techniques and evolving motion editing technologies
Work collaboratively on research projects within a globally-based team
Support research through building experimental pipelines and prototypes
Handle data processing and preparation at scale
Conduct model training and hyperparameter tuning
Analyze model errors and design strategies for mitigation
Leverage cutting edge coding tools for high velocity. Maintain high standards of engineering, scalable implementations for shared code repos

MS, or PhD in a field related to AI/ML such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related discipline
Proficiency in Deep Learning techniques (Network architectures, regularization techniques, learning techniques, loss-functions, optimization strategies, etc.)
Deep background in statistical methods for Machine Learning (Bayesian methods, HMMs, graphical models, dimension reduction, clustering, classification, regression techniques, etc.)
Experience with multiple assisted coding environments
Strategies for best practices for high-velocity and scalable assisted code generation
Computational time-series data analytics and prediction regimes
Proficiency with scalable compute, bandwidth and storage infrastructure and associated orchestration layer

Profound understanding of fundamental CS algorithms and their scaling behaviors
Practical experience in applying machine learning algorithms and libraries to business problems


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in production environments and creative workflows in the entertainment or adjacent industries

Familiarity with media pipelines and practical application of data modeling

Ability to decompose large problems into manageable components and develop clear solutions
Proactive and self-motivated attitude towards problem solving

Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to learn and adapt in newly forming areas

Title: Business Advisor, Data and Analytics
Description:
Come work as a Business Advisor, Data & Analytics with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH)!

Vancouver Coastal Health is looking for a Business Advisor, Data & Analytics to join the Health Analytics Team. Apply today to join our team!

As a Business Advisor, Data & Analytics with Vancouver Coastal Health you will:


Examine and interpret organizational data to unlock valuable insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Support the department’s mission to enhance data-driven decision processes, identify meaningful trends, and contribute significantly to the improvement of our business operations.
Collaborate with partners across the organization to understand and gather data requirements.
Build and applies effective data models to support business objectives.
Utilize a variety of analytical tools and techniques to generate comprehensive reports and visualizations.
Analyze complex data sets to provide useful insights into business outcomes.
Contribute to the development and execution of data-driven strategies for business optimization.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all analytical activities.
Keep up with industry developments and innovations in data analytics and business intelligence tools.
Carry out responsibilities in accordance with health and safety requirements.
Immediately report unsafe situations by notifying supervisor or other appropriate personnel.
Perform other related duties as assigned.


This work is framed within VCH’s commitments to our pillars of Indigenous Cultural Safety, Anti-Racism, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, and Planetary Health.

The hours of work including days off and work area may be subject to change consistent with operational requirements and the provision of the Collective Agreement and applicable statutes. Successful applicants may be required to complete a Criminal Records Review Check.

As per Ministry of Health policy, all health care workers working in publicly-funded health care facilities are required to report their past receipt of certain vaccines or history of certain infections. For all new hires and appointments to Vancouver Coastal Health, you will be asked to provide this information as part of the onboarding process.

VCH is a world class innovator in medical care, research and teaching, delivering service to more than one million BC residents. At VCH, we embrace thinking boldly, taking smart risks, and 'going first' when we believe it will lead to the best possible outcomes for patients and their families. We invite you to join us in creating healthy lives in healthy communities by showcasing our passion for care, connection to the communities we serve and our culture of teamwork that makes VCH a great place to work.


Comprehensive health benefits package, including MSP, extended health and dental and municipal pension plan
Grow your career with employer-paid training and leadership development opportunities
Wellness supports, including counselling, critical incident and innovative wellness services are available to employees and their immediate families
Award-winning recognition programs to honour staff, medical staff and volunteers
Access to exclusive discount offers and deals for VCH staff


At Vancouver Coastal Health, our vision of healthy lives in healthy communities inspires us and our values and pillars guide us. We support equitable practices, diverse teams and inclusive environments, which are vital to creating welcoming spaces where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and feel supported. We encourage applications from equity-deserving communities, including Indigenous Peoples and members of racialized groups, people with disabilities and people of all gender identities and expressions and sexual orientation.

Vancouver Coastal Health is proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers, BC’s Top Employers, Canada’s Best Diversity Employers and Canada's Top Employers for Young People in 2026.

Only short-listed applicants will be contacted for this posting.

Refer to the https://my.vch.ca/working-here/job-postings site for instructions on how to view internal job postings and how to apply as an employee. Current VCH employees who apply to this posting using this external site will be considered as an external candidate. Seniority will not apply.***

Thank you for your interest in Vancouver Coastal Health.

Education & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field, with a minimum of three (3) years’ recent, related experience in data analysis, business analytics, or a similar role, with a preference for experience in the healthcare sector or in organizations of comparable complexity. Demonstrated ability to apply data modelling, analysis, and visualization techniques in a business context.


Knowledge & Abilities


Proven experience in data analysis, business analytics, or a similar role.
Advanced proficiency in analytical tools and software (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of database systems like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think analytically.
Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and predictive modeling, capable of applying these techniques to forecast trends and inform strategic decisions. Strong understanding of data privacy and security principles, especially relevant in the healthcare industry, to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of sensitive information.
Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into understandable insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in stakeholder management, with a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with various departments and communicate complex data insights to non-technical audiences effectively.
A collaborative team player with a proven track record of working effectively with cross-functional teams.
Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to accuracy and quality.
Develops and maintains strong relationships with key internal and external partners to promote and enhance services provided with sensitivity to diversity and indigenous lens.
Practices the recognition, inclusion and support of all types and aspects of diversity at all stages of engagement, with an understanding of the issues faced by people from equity-deserving groups.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

Title: Analyst, Analytics Platform and Methodology
Description:
Are you interested in joining one of Canada’s top-performing asset managers? We are looking for an Analyst to join our Platform and Methodology (PaM) team. In this position, you will help drive the digital transformation of our business by developing and modernizing our analytics platform. You will contribute across the full analytics delivery lifecycle, including methodology, design, and implementation, and work on high-impact solutions that support investment analytics across the organization.

The PaM team acts as a steward of the financial group’s analytics platform and is responsible for the delivery of post-trade and custom affiliate analytics. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-impact, high-skill team whose scope and impact continue to grow.

What You Will Do


Manage the end-to-end analytics production pipeline including ingestion, calculation, and distribution.
Identify, develop, source, and implement scalable analytics solutions across performance, attribution, risk, exposure, and investment models.
Support and enhance both proprietary analytics products and third-party tools such as Revolution, Bloomberg, and eVestment.
Develop and maintain dashboards and the semantic layer that supports natural language query (NLQ)
Investigate and resolve complex issues using your strong understanding of analytics methodologies.
Translate business logic and technical concepts for stakeholders, including portfolio managers and performance analysts.
Identify and implement workflow improvements that increase efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance service for stakeholders.


What You Bring


An undergraduate degree in finance, data science, or a quantitative field. Completion of a relevant designation, such as the CFA or FRM, is an asset.
You have deep knowledge in investment analytics, investment management, or data science. You are a systems thinker and take ownership of your work. Experience implementing performance and analytics systems (Revolution, BNY Data and Analytics, Simcorp Investment Analytics, etc.) is an asset.
You have practical experience with the tools and systems used in modern analytics pipelines. Experience with Python, SQL, AI programming assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot), automation and scheduling platforms (e.g. VisualCron, Prefect), data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Microsoft Fabric), and data visualization tools (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau) is an asset. Experience developing AI solutions is an asset.
Passionate about technology and are committed to continuous learning. You apply and integrate emerging technologies where they add value. You bring the “art of the possible” to solution design.
Strong problem solver who can identify patterns, generate insights, and approach ambiguous problems with structure and creativity.
You can communicate complex concepts clearly and build alignment across stakeholders at all levels. You have a collaborative spirit, can navigate different perspectives, and promote alignment toward common organizational goals.
Identify, assess, and mitigate process risks, and escalate issues proactively when needed.
You can use judgement to make sound decisions in a timely fashion under ambiguity. You are self-directed, proactive, and comfortable proposing solutions.


The expected base salary range for this position is $85,000–$120,000. The midpoint represents our general market target for a fully qualified and experienced individual performing the role. Actual starting salary may fall below or above the midpoint depending on the candidate's relevant experience, skills and qualifications, as well as internal equity considerations. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

What We Offer

At Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group, we’re "invested in our greatest asset, you". Our shared goals reflect what matters most to our people:


Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our flexible work practices are designed to support work-life balance and provide employees with flexibility in where and how they work
Your growth: we prioritize your development with meaningful work, continuous learning budgets, paid study days and support for professional designations.
Recognizing you: your contributions are rewarded with competitive total compensation, retirement savings support, wellness credits, enhanced parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits.


For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com.

Title: Actuarial Analyst II
Description:
Why BCAA?

Feel proud of what you do and help shape the future of BC at a BC Top Employer. We’re driven by purpose – delivering peace of mind to one in three BC households with insurance, roadside assistance, auto repair, Evo Car Share and Evolve E-Bike Share. With a long history of keeping roads safe and giving back in ways that build stronger communities, we offer a wide variety of meaningful, rewarding careers that move BC forward.

We are currently hiring an Actuarial Analyst (Level I OR II) based in our Head Office in Burnaby.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based out of our Burnaby, BC office. Applicants who are not located within commuting distance of our Head Office or are not looking to relocate to the Greater Vancouver/Lower Mainland/Fraser Valley region will not be considered.

As an Actuarial Analyst (Level I OR II), you’ll play a key role in supporting pricing sophistication, underwriting capability, and product development for BCAA’s Property & Casualty insurance products. This role blends actuarial analysis with hands-on problem solving to deliver insights that enhance rating methodologies, support P&C portfolio performance, and strengthen decision-making across our insurance business.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone progressing through CAS actuarial exams who wants to grow in a collaborative, corporate environment. You’ll work closely with senior actuarial team members, contribute to research and predictive modeling projects, and gain valuable exposure to property and casualty insurance analysis, product design, and risk assessment.

Who you are:


You are analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong foundation in actuarial methods and insurance concepts.
You thrive on problem-solving and enjoy using data to uncover insights and develop practical solutions.
You are highly organized, capable of managing competing priorities with accuracy and focus.
You work well independently but also collaborate effectively in a team environment.
You’re motivated to continue writing CAS actuarial exams and building your actuarial career.
You communicate technical findings clearly, tailoring your message to both technical and non-technical audiences.



What you’ll do:


Contribute to the development of rating models and actuarial analyses to support product pricing and underwriting strategies.
Assist in preparing and reviewing actuarial studies, including loss ratio analysis, trend analysis, reinsurance governance, etc.
Work with senior team members to scope projects and establish appropriate actuarial or statistical approaches.
Extract, clean, and analyze internal and external data sources to build accurate actuarial datasets.
Document methodologies and summarize results in a clear, concise manner for senior actuaries and leadership.
Contribute to research projects to deepen understanding of insurance portfolio performance and emerging risks.
Continuously build actuarial knowledge while proactively sharing insights with team members.



What you bring:


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, or a related quantitative field.
Minimum 2 years of actuarial or analytical experience, ideally within insurance. Consideration will also be given to candidates with relevant project or internship experience.
Completion of at least 2 CAS actuarial exams, with continued progress towards an Associate designation.
Knowledge of actuarial concepts including pricing, reserving, and risk analysis.
Strong skills in statistical tools/languages such as R or Python.
Experience working with large datasets and databases, and the ability to query, merge, and prepare data this data.
Solid written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences.
A proactive approach to problem solving, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Experience with dashboarding/visualization tools such as PowerBI or Tableau.
Exposure to machine learning algorithms, clustering, or advanced predictive modeling.
Familiarity with insurance product development or regulatory filings.
Understanding of GIS or spatial analytics tools.
Bonus Skills & Experience:
Experience with predictive modeling or machine learning techniques applied to P&C insurance.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements impacting property and casualty insurance.
Knowledge of claims analytics, loss development, and reserving methodologies.
Exposure to reinsurance structures and their impact on portfolio management.



The salary range for this position is $75,363.00 to $103,624.44 and is determined via job-related knowledge, skills, experience, certifications, market demand and internal equity. In addition to base salary and BCAA benefits, this position is eligible for a performance bonus target of 9%, with the opportunity to earn up to 15%.

What we offer:


The chance to make a difference every day in the lives of British Columbians, BCAA Members and our communities.
Career and personal development to help you grow and reach your goals.
Incentives that recognize team and individual sales and performance.
Flexible benefits to support your health and lifestyle, and wellness dollars* to keep your body, mind and soul thriving.
A competitive rewards package including salary performance bonus programs, pension plan*, and more to help build your personal wealth.
Paid time off including vacation, and days for wellness, volunteering, and cultural, spiritual or religious connection.
BCAA membership, with valuable perks and Member savings on every day and special spending, from gas and coffee to clothes, sports and event tickets, and hotels.
Meaningful, rewarding work for a BC Top Employer known for putting people first and constantly building a better workplace for all our team members.

Title: Machine learning Engineer
Description:
Job Description

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll design and implement scalable, high-performance machine learning systems to support DeviantArt's vibrant online community. You'll play a key role in building innovative solutions that enhance user experiences and foster creativity within a high-traffic environment.


Develop and improve algorithms for recommendations and classification to enhance user experiences
Implement and deploy reliable machine learning systems for an active online art community
Build end-to-end systems, from data ingestion to serving results in production
Stay up-to-date with developments in data and machine learning engineering, applying them to DeviantArt systems and goals


Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Machine Learning or closely related disciplines
Understanding of machine learning algorithms, especially for recommendation and classification
Experience designing and deploying cloud-based production systems
Expertise with large-scale data processing and machine learning infrastructure
Familiarity with Python and technologies like Apache Spark, AWS, and PyTorch
Knowledge of large language models and their applications to recommendation and classification
Experience with serverless approaches or large-scale search engines like Elasticsearch or Vespa – an advantage


This is a hybrid position, and the team is expected to come to the office 1 day per week.

Additional Information

The DeviantArt Artificial Intelligence team is part of DeviantArt, the largest online social network for artists and art enthusiasts. Founded in 2000 and part of Wix since 2017, DeviantArt empowers artists to exhibit, promote, and share their works with an enthusiastic, art-centric community. With over 115 million registered users and tens of thousands of original art pieces uploaded daily, DeviantArt fosters creativity and community. The Artificial Intelligence team focuses on developing innovative solutions to enhance user experience, support artistic creativity, and ensure safe interactions within the platform.

We believe the best innovation happens when we mix deep focus work with in-person connection. While you'll work from home most of the week, we require this person to be in our Vancouver office every Thursday.

The approximate base compensation is $165,000 - 200,000 CAD In addition to base pay you will receive company RSUs as part of the compensation package.

The final offer may vary and will be determined by various factors including candidate profile and ideal qualifications.


Location: Candidates must be currently located in the Greater Vancouver Area, BC.
Work Authorization: Candidates must possess current, valid work authorization to work legally in Canada without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

About QuadReal Property Group

QuadReal Property Group is a global real estate investment, development and operating company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia. Its assets under management are $98.5 billion. From its foundation in Canada as a full-service real estate operating company, QuadReal has expanded its capabilities globally for investments in equity and debt in both the public and private markets. QuadReal invests directly through operating platforms in which it holds an ownership interest and via programmatic partnerships.

QuadReal seeks to deliver strong investment returns while creating sustainable environments that bring value to the people and communities it serves. Now and for generations to come.

QuadReal: Excellence lives here.

www.quadreal.com

Role Description:

The Data Analyst - Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt (12 month Contract) will report directly to the Director, Portfolio Reporting, Real Estate Debt. We are seeking a highly motivated individual with a background in Data Science or Data Analytics who is looking to develop their career in an entrepreneurial and high-energy environment. Embedded within the business, this role supports management reporting, forecasting, and portfolio analysis across the RE Debt portfolio, in addition to being the primary liaison to ED&A and IT — translating reporting requirements into data specifications and building data flows from the Enterprise Data Platform through to the reporting layer. This position also works closely with the Real Estate Debt Investment, Accounting, and Operations teams, FP&A, and Portfolio Management teams across QuadReal.

Role Description:


Support scenario modelling, cash flow forecasting, leverage and liquidity analysis through Anaplan, supplemented by ad-hoc financial models as needed, using AI-assisted development for efficiency and quality control
Analyze portfolio exposures, return attribution, and market trends, and support the development of presentation materials with AIenhanced insights and visualization
Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and ad hoc management reports for senior management, Board of Directors and BCI
Support real estate debt investment underwriting by providing portfolio impact analysis
Assist with ad hoc research projects for benchmarking, peer analysis, risk analysis, and other relevant topics
Query and extract data from enterprise data platforms to support portfolio reporting and analytics needs
Develop and maintain business logic, portfolio calculations, and data transformation rules that underpin reporting outputs
Serve as the primary business-side liaison to IT and ED&A, translating reporting requirements into data specifications and validating platform outputs
Support data enablement initiatives and ongoing data management and governance priorities across the RE Debt portfolio
Validate and reconcile data collected from different systems using AI-powered anomaly detection to improve data quality and identify process improvement opportunities


Experience And Qualifications:


University degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field) OR a background in Economics, Finance or a related business field. CFA or similar designation is a plus
2–3 years of experience working in a data analyst role, ideally in investment management or real estate.
Analytical – Strong quantitative and analytical skills; detail-oriented and proficient in building and handling complicated data sets.
Excellent communication and presentation skills; demonstrates an ability to effectively communicate and present results that articulate key themes and messages.
Must be able to allocate time effectively and work under pressure to meet tight deadlines, handle multiple demands and competing priorities, and adapt to new ideas and change. Comfortable following direction but also contributing to the direction.
Advanced knowledge of SQL, Power Query, Excel, and Power BI is required. Familiarity with Anaplan or a similar planning tool is an asset. Experience with Tableau or Python is considered a plus.
Proactive approach to leveraging technology for process improvement and analytical enhancement. Comfortable learning and applying new tools, automation techniques, GenAI applications (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot), and advanced analytics platforms to solve complex problems, automate data analysis, rapidly prototype financial models, and deliver higher-quality insights.
Has a questioning frame of mind, asks “why” and challenges the status quo with improvements to drive change when needed.


The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $74,000-$84,000.

The actual salary offered will take into consideration a wide array of factors including, but not limited to, the individual’s skill, experience, education and training, the market compensation of the role, and the consideration to internal equity.

We value diverse experiences and perspectives. Even if your skills don’t align 100% with the listed qualifications or salary range, we encourage you to apply – you may be a great fit for this role or others in our community. Applicants may also be considered for alternative positions within the organization where their qualifications and experience align more closely with available opportunities.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) technology — alongside human review — to assist in screening and assessing applicants for this position. Our recruitment team remains involved in all decisions.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada as the company does not provide work permit sponsorship for this role.

Note to Recruiters: QuadReal does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Any unsolicited resumes sent to QuadReal, directly or indirectly, will be considered QuadReal property. QuadReal will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. A recruiting agency must first have a valid, written and fully executed agency agreement contract for engaged services to submit resumes.

QuadReal Property Group will provide reasonable accommodation at any time throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities or for those needing job postings in an alternate format. If you require accommodation, please advise the Talent Acquisition team member you are working with and include the following: Job posting #, your name and your preferred method of contact.

Title: Load Forecast Advisor
Description:
Job Location: Vancouver, BC

Employment type: Permanent

Hours of work: Full-time (37.5 hrs/week)

Annual Salary: $ 109,680 -$138,720

No. of positions: 1

Closing date: October 9th, 2026




What you'll do




The load forecast is a critical foundation of BC Hydro’s Integrated Resource Plan and is used across the company for capital planning, operations planning, revenue forecasting, and other functions. As a Load Forecast Advisor or Senior Load Forecast Advisor in the Industrial Load Forecast team, you will be responsible for producing energy and peak demand forecasts for BC Hydro’s industrial customers as a key member of a broader energy planning group. You will be expected to produce load forecasts using well-established modelling methods, and to develop new modelling methods to forecast emerging loads and sectors.




This position is open to either an Intermediate or Senior level candidate, with future progression within the role possible. Once a selection is made the team will determine which level to offer based on selected candidates’ education, experience and skill set.




The Annual Salary range would be reflected below:




* Load Forecast Advisor (Intermediate): $89,910 - $113,720

* Sr. Load Forecast Advisor: $109,700.00 - $138,700.00




The main responsibilities associated with delivering timely and accurate forecasts include:




* Utilizes economic models and relationships in delivering industrial load forecasts.




* Proactively identifies emerging drivers—including load, economic, customer, and end-use factors—that may impact future industrial demand.

• Understands industrial customers’ expansion, electrification, and decarbonization roadmaps.

• Translates policy and regulatory changes into long-term load forecasting scenarios.




* Coordinates the efforts of consultants, data providers and department peers where necessary to facilitate the creation of the industrial sector forecasts. Advises the manager on budget requirements.




* Regularly monitors performance of existing forecasting models and processes. Monitor industry developments with respect to models and forecasting methodologies.




* Proactively builds, maintains and manages ongoing internal and external working relationships.




Additional Responsibilities for the Senior Load Forecast Advisor:




* Leads complex forecasting studies and establishes the analytical approach and delivery plan for key industrial sub-sectors such as oil and gas, mining, forestry, emerging industries (such as AI, data centers, hydrogen), load and market research programs and customer surveys.




* Provides independent leadership for a larger portfolio of projects than the Load Forecast Advisor, ensuring successful delivery of key business objectives.




* Planning, organizing and implementing the annual work schedule. Coordinating the integration of sector forecasts within regional and system load forecasts and with other critical and complex company processes




* Establishes and ensures new modelling methodologies are appropriate and carries out due diligence over data.




* Leads continuous improvement of forecasting models, methodologies, data practices, and workflows and promotes adoption of improved approaches within the load forecasting team.




* Exercises independent judgment in analysis and problem solving on highly complex and medium scope problems.




What you bring




* Load Forecast Advisor (Intermediate):




• 2-5 years of relevant work experience, with some experience in the conduct of load research or economic studies.




• Good data management and attention to detail.




* OR Senior Load Forecast Advisor:




• A minimum of 6-8 years of relevant experience with demonstrated depth in one or more of the following areas: industrial project development proposals, existing industrial operations analysis, policy analysis, energy industry developments and forecasting, data management and analytics.




• Ability to lead processes independently and drive continuous improvement initiatives.




• Advanced technical leadership skills in forecasting or industrial sector. Understanding of the operational profiles, production cycles, and energy requirements of major industrial sectors




• A master’s degree in a relevant discipline is an asset.




Common Requirements:




• Post-secondary degree in relevant areas such as economics, engineering, business, or other relevant discipline.




• Demonstrated capability of designing and building analytical models and/or conducting industrial sector market research.




• Demonstrated competency with MS Office suite, particularly Excel.




• Demonstrated oral and written communications skills, including the ability to prepare PowerPoint slides, write briefing notes and make presentations for senior leaders.




• Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of multidisciplinary teams comprising consultants and employees.




• Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships and manage stakeholder expectations.




Preferences:




Any combination of the following would be considered an asset:




• Understanding of how energy is used today, and how that use might change in future, for one or more of BC Hydro’s major customer groups (heavy industry including natural gas production, processing and transport; mining; forestry; datacenters)




• Certified Energy Manager designation




What we offer




- A comprehensive benefits package

- A minimum of 15 paid vacation days

- A lifetime pension

- Flexible work model, depending on your role type

- Training and development courses




For more information on the benefits we offer, visit bchydro.com/benefits.




* This is a Hybrid role; however there are times that this role will require in-office attendance at BC Hydro’s downtown Vancouver location, up to five days a week.




How to apply




Interested candidates should submit their applications online at https://app.bchydro.com/careers/current_opp.html or click ‘Apply’




You must use a supported browser, such as Firefox, Internet Explorer, Google Chrome or Safari. Your pop up blocker will also need to be disabled for the BC Hydro Careers site.




On the BC Hydro Careers site, click on the Apply button in order to complete the steps to apply for this job. Please be sure to update your Candidate Profile with your current resume and include copies of your certifications, if applicable.

Title: Principal Resource Geologist
Description:
Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada

Employment Type: Regular Full Time

Workplace Type: Hybrid

About Our Vancouver Office

Located in the heart of downtown Vancouver, between the Pacific Ocean and the Coast Mountains, Teck’s Corporate Office sits in one of Canada’s most culturally diverse cities.

Surrounded by world-renowned nature and globally inspired cuisine, the office brings together many of Teck’s corporate functions - all working toward Teck’s purpose of providing the essential resources the world relies on.

Role Overview

Strategic Planning (SP) at Highland Valley Copper (HVC) is responsible for ensuring the long-term (3+ year) value and resiliency of the operation. The Geology function within SP provides authoritative geological and resource knowledge across all four pits to ensure optimal extraction of value across the full mining value chain.

As Principal Resource Geologist, you are the technical authority and accountable owner of the HVC Mineral Resource Models. You provide oversight, assurance, and governance for resource model development, updates, and application, ensuring models are technically robust, auditable, fit-for-purpose, and consistently applied across Life of Asset (LOA) planning, reserves, mine planning, and strategic decision-making.

This role extends beyond model construction to include coordination and alignment with downstream users of the models—including planning, engineering, operations, metallurgy, and projects—to ensure correct interpretation, appropriate use, and clear communication of uncertainty and risk. You will set standards, define workflows and expectations, and ensure consistency in how resource models inform business decisions at HVC.

You are a recognized technical leader with deep expertise in geostatistics, estimation, and complex porphyry systems, combined with the judgment and influence required to guide high-impact decisions. You are expected to mentor senior practitioners, and influence across disciplines.

This position reports to the Chief Geologist - HVC, SP Geology, and is based in Vancouver, BC, with the option to work remotely up to two days per week. Regular travel to HVC is required (approximately 1 week every 4–6 weeks, with additional travel as business needs dictate).

Key Responsibilities

Safety & Leadership


Act as a courageous and visible safety leader by actively promoting, endorsing, and role-modeling Teck’s safety, environmental, and sustainability values in all interactions and decisions
Take proactive ownership of safety performance by identifying improvement opportunities, engaging stakeholders, and driving actions through to measurable outcomes
Actively participate in safety conversations, field engagements, and risk assessments to reinforce a strong safety culture
Embed safety, hazard awareness, and risk-based thinking into all geological modelling activities, workflows, and decision-support processes


Technical Authority & Governance


Serve as the technical authority for Mineral Resource Models at HVC, accountable for methodology selection, assumptions, validation, and model integrity
Establish, maintain, and evolve standards, guidelines, and best practices for resource modelling, estimation, and classification at HVC
Provide technical sign-off and assurance for resource models used in LOA planning, strategic studies, projects, and public disclosure.


Resource & Reserve Oversight


Provide senior leadership and technical oversight of the annual Resource and Reserve (R&R) process, ensuring compliance with internal standards and external reporting codes
Interface with Qualified Persons, auditors, and reviewers, addressing technical challenges and defending methodologies and outcomes


Cross-Functional Coordination & Model Use


Lead engagement with mine planning, engineering, metallurgy, operations, and projects teams to ensure appropriate and consistent use of resource models
Clearly communicate model assumptions, limitations, uncertainty, and risk to non-geologists to support informed business decisions
Resolve technical misalignment between resource models and downstream applications


Geological Understanding & Model Evolution


Maintain and continuously refine a deep understanding of the HVC mineral system and its spatial, geological, and metallurgical controls
Oversee the integration of geology, structure, geochemistry, geophysics, geometallurgy, and production reconciliation into evolving models
Guide decisions on model resolution, estimation approaches, and classification strategies aligned with business objectives


Innovation & Continuous Improvement


Champion the adoption of advanced and fit-for-purpose modelling approaches, including rapid modelling workflows, conditional simulation, uncertainty analysis, and scenario evaluation
Evaluate advanced modelling and planning techniques leading piloting and implementation where value is demonstrated


Strategic Programs & Advisory Role


Provide senior technical input into the design and prioritization of resource confidence, geometallurgical, geotechnical, and expansion/exploration programs
Act as a trusted advisor to Strategic Planning and site leadership on resource-related risks, opportunities, and trade-offs


Capability Building & Mentorship


Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and coaching to senior and developing geoscientists across HVC and Teck
Build organizational capability by sharing knowledge, reviewing work, and fostering a culture of inclusive technical excellence and rigor.


Qualifications


Degree in Geoscience or a related discipline (e.g., geostatistics, geometallurgy, geochemistry). MSc or PhD strongly preferred;
Registered Professional Geoscientist (or eligible) with Engineers and Geoscientists British Columbia
12+ years of progressive experience in resource geology within mining operations, advanced projects, or applied research, including significant experience at a senior level;
Demonstrated accountability for complex resource models supporting LOA planning, reserves, and strategic investment decisions
Expert-level understanding of geostatistics, estimation theory, resource classification, and uncertainty management
Advanced proficiency in 3D geological modelling and estimation software (Leapfrog GEO, EDGE required; Vulcan or equivalent an asset)
Extensive experience with porphyry copper deposits and large, complex open pit operations
Strong background in geochemistry and integrated multi-disciplinary data analysis across the mining value chain
Advanced quantitative and analytical skills, including expert use of R, Python, ioGAS, or similar tools; experience applying data science or machine learning techniques to geological problems is an asset
Proven ability to influence without authority and operate effectively across disciplines and organizational boundariesExceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.


Leadership Competencies


Demonstrates visible leadership in health, safety, environment, community, and sustainability
Proven ability to build cross-functional partnerships through collaborative influence and constructive feedback, ensuring stakeholders feel supported
Demonstrates emotional intelligence while challenging the status quo to ensure a culture of mutual respect
Acts with integrity, sound judgment, and accountability, setting the technical and ethical standard for others
Thinks strategically, balancing technical rigor with business value and practicality
Drives results through influence, prioritization, and disciplined execution
Understands and navigates organizational systems, processes, and governance to achieve outcomes.


Pay Range: CAD $138,000 - $170,000 per year

The actual amount offered is determined based on the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and competencies and considers internal equity.

Why Teck

At Teck, your work matters—to the world, to our communities and to your future.

As a leading Canadian resource company, we focus on responsibly providing the metals essential for global development and the energy transition while caring for the people, communities and land that we love. We do this guided by our values that, together, form The Teck Way. At Teck, you’ll find purpose-driven work, a culture of respect and inclusion, and the opportunity to grow your career while helping build a better world.

Apply with us

Take the next step in your career by applying for the Principal Resource Geologist role. We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn’t match every requirement. We value diversity and are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free hiring process. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

Title: AI/ML Engineer
Description:
About EviSmart

EviSmart builds the automation layer that dental laboratories run on.

A dental lab is a manufacturing operation. A case arrives from a dentist — a 3D scan of a patient's mouth and a prescription — and leaves as a crown, bridge, denture or night guard. In between sit a dozen manual steps: monitoring scanner portals, retyping cases into lab software, checking scan quality, interpreting handwritten prescriptions, designing the restoration.

We automate that pipeline. Our software connects to 15 intraoral scanner portals and more than five lab management systems, pulls cases the moment they arrive, reads the prescription, maps it into the lab's own product catalogue, checks the scan, and routes it to design. We serve roughly 6,000 customers across 28 countries from offices in Vancouver, Manila, Seoul and Shenzhen.

The automation works. It does not yet work well enough, consistently enough, to run unattended — and closing that gap is the highest-leverage technical problem in the company.

What you'll do

Establish measurement. Build per-model, per-customer, per-category accuracy reporting that Product and Sales can act on. Nothing else you do matters until this exists.
Build the correction flywheel. Capture the quality-control corrections our customers already make, turn them into structured, versioned training data, and close the loop with human review where confidence is low.
Standardize the squads. One deployment path, one evaluation harness, one model and dataset registry across restoration design, scan quality, prescription extraction and agents.
Solve multi-tenant model behaviour. Thousands of customer-specific product codes, prescription conventions and unwritten preferences sitting over a shared model base — without building a bespoke model per customer.
Take inference to production scale. Move workloads from on-premise to cloud with understood cost per inference and real concurrency headroom.

• • Set technical direction for AI across the company, partnering closely with the CTO, Product and the operations teams in Manila who currently absorb the work our models can't yet do.

• • • • Before you apply — how we work
This is a full-time in-office role at our Vancouver office, five days a week. We are not offering remote or hybrid arrangements for this position, and this is not negotiable at offer stage.
We're explicit about it because the work genuinely depends on it. You'll be standardizing how four existing AI squads build, working across a Manila engineering organization, and spending real time with the operations people who currently absorb the work our models can't yet do. That happens in a room.
If you're looking for remote or hybrid, this isn't the right role and we'd rather not waste your time.

What we're looking for
Required
Significant experience building and operating machine learning platforms in production — model registries, versioned datasets, CI for models, monitoring, rollback. Not research infrastructure.
Depth in document and information extraction from unstructured, inconsistent text. Prescriptions are the core data object here and they are messy.
You have built a system where user corrections became better models, and you can walk through exactly how the data moved.
Genuine evaluation rigour — you can define what "accurate" means for a given category, defend it, and ship against it.
Judgment about when not to use a model. A significant share of this problem is classification and mapping, and deterministic rules beat ML for a lot of it.
Ability to align engineers across squads and time zones without formal reporting authority.
Strongly preferred
Multi-tenant or per-customer model behaviour at scale.
3D or geometry-based ML — directly relevant to scan quality and restoration design.
Experience with healthcare or other regulated data; patient privacy and data residency are live constraints for us.
Inference cost management and on-premise to cloud migration.

• • Not required
Dental or medical-device background. The workflow is learnable in an afternoon and we would rather have platform depth. What we do want is curiosity about a strange, physical, high-stakes manufacturing process — the output of our software ends up in someone's mouth.

What success looks like

By 90 days — you can tell us, with evidence, where our models actually fail and for which customers. The squads agree on a single evaluation standard.

By six months — customer corrections flow into training data automatically. At least one production model has measurably improved through that loop.

By twelve months — prescription quality control runs with confidence thresholds, routing only genuinely ambiguous cases to human review. We can state our accuracy publicly and defend it in a sales conversation.

Why this role

Larger competitors have bigger AI teams and a five-year head start on modelling. We are not trying to beat them at that.

We are trying to build something they structurally cannot: a system that gets better every time one of six thousand laboratories tells us we got something wrong. That data exists. The loop does not.

If you have built this kind of flywheel before — or you have been close enough to one to know exactly why most of them fail — we should talk.

Genome Sciences Centre

Vancouver, BC

The Computational Biologist participates in developing, improving and maintaining bioinformatics tools for high-throughput processing pipelines. Title: Senior Groundwater Modeler
Description:
We are SLR Consulting (Canada), an 1000+ team of advisory, environmental, engineering, and regulatory professionals across Canada. We deliver services through the integration of over 30 disciplines to help clients address some of their most complex challenges around sustainability. We are Making Sustainability Happen.

As our new Senior Groundwater Modeler you will play an important role on a team whose work is essential to achieving this goal. Success in this complex, multi-faceted role will depend on your demonstrated skills and depth of experience in mentorship, business development, and client service, as well as your technical mastery of the field.

The successful applicant will join a team of senior hydrogeologists that supports mining companies worldwide in managing mine water issues, including mine de-watering, groundwater impact assessment, seepage control and mitigation. You will be responsible for contributing to hydrogeological projects in Canada and abroad (Australia, Central and South America) and will work closely with our team of groundwater modelers.

This is a challenging position and will require a well-rounded individual with a willingness to learn, improve technical abilities, and work independently. You will be required to travel to our domestic or international project sites. We offer the flexibility of a hybrid work arrangement.

Responsibilities


Collaborate with the SLR team on hydrogeological projects in Canada, Australia, and South America.
Develop and refine groundwater flow & contaminant transport models with input from senior staff and other team members.
Review and interpret variety of groundwater-related data and information as part of conceptual and numerical modeling
Develop 3D hydrogeological conceptual models using designated software


Working @ SLR

EDC Student Internships / New Grad Positions - Technology and Analytics Stream (Winter 2027)

About EDC: At Export Development Canada (EDC), we empower Canadian businesses to succeed globally. As a Financial Crown corporation, we offer innovative financial solutions and expert insights to help businesses explore new markets, mitigate risks, and achieve growth.

Why Join EDC?


Collaborate with a diverse, experienced team
Thrive in a supportive, teamwork-driven environment
Impact global communities through sustainable growth in emerging markets
Recognized as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers, Best Diversity Employers, and a Top 100 Family-Friendly Employers
Enjoy a comprehensive Total Rewards package, including benefits, vacation, wellness programs, and professional development opportunities


Student and New Grad Opportunities

Our student and new grad opportunities include internships and co-op programs, all designed to give your career a strong start. Winter work terms begin at four months in length and may be extended for an additional four months or more, depending on business needs. While most roles are full-time, there is flexibility for part-time work.

Our program is ideal for early career professionals who are new grads that have completed their courses within the past year, as well as students in their current program of study. Work terms in our program can be counted towards an accredited co-op program with your university or college.

We are actively recruiting early career professionals for the 2027 Winter semester in various teams looking for Technology and Analytics students or new grads. Team assignments will vary, and detailed descriptions will be provided if selected for an interview.

Apply to this pool if you are a student or new grad who is:


Studying or has studied - Computer Science, Business Technology, Data Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or related
Interested in either development, analytics, software, business analysis, or similar
A Business OR a Technology focused student wanting to work in the IT space of an organization
Looking to gain experience in a Crown Corporation and develop foundational skills for your career in business.


Our Ideal Student or New Grad:


Currently enrolled or recently graduated from an undergraduate or graduate program (eligible for up to one year after completion of studies).
Available for 8 months or more - While roles will be available for 4-month terms, preference will be given to candidates with availability that extends.
Previous work term experience related to their field of study
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Motivated self-starter, good organizational and analytical skills
Ability to work independently and within a team
Enthusiasm to tackle any task, whether menial or complex
Knowledge of both official languages is an asset and may be required for certain positions


What can you expect from an EDC work term?

The opportunity to build cross-functional professional networks, identify and pursue opportunities for improvement and innovation, and continuously learn and grow through coaching and mentoring from professionals throughout EDC. Work in a high-performing, fast-paced and flexible environment facilitated by technologies and report to any of our EDC Hubs across Canada.

What to expect from us?


You will be notified when we have received your application.
If your profile matches a team's needs, we will reach out to schedule an interview with the team, you will receive a description of the team you are selected for in preparation for your interview.
We will be contacting candidates on a rolling basis from October through December 2026 for interviews, dependent on business needs. 


Compensation Details:

Student, New Grad & Master's salaries range from $42,900 to $56,550 annually, based on year of study. Please see the salary breakdown by year of study below:


1st Year: $42,900 ($22.00/hour)
2nd Year: $44,850 ($23.00/hour)
3rd Year: $46,800 ($24.00/hour)
4th Year and Beyond: $48,750 ($25.00/hour)
New Graduate (Undergraduate): $54,600 ($28.00/hour)
Master's/PhD: $56,550 ($29.00/hour)


Location: 


Export Development Canada operates under a hybrid work model, with employees currently required to work from the office three days per wee
Opportunities may be performed from EDC's headquarters in Ottawa. There will be limited opportunities also available from our Community Hubs located in Toronto, Mississauga, Montreal, Brossard, Laval, Calgary, Edmonton, Halifax, or Vancouver

EDC is committed to Fair Employment Practices and preference will be given to a candidate who is able to work legally in Canada at the time of application (Canadian Citizen, Permanent Residents or Work Permit). This position is open to individuals who meet all the essential criteria outlined above and submit their applications by the closing date. Ready to make a difference? This is your chance to join a dynamic, growing team and leave your mark on our organization, development finance, and the world.

Apply today!

Want to learn more about EDC? Check our website here https://www.edc.ca

Export Development Canada (EDC) is dedicated to fostering employment equity and building a diverse workforce. Title: Analytics Engineer - Senior Consultant or Consultant
Description:
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value.

At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.




Job Title: Analytics Engineer - Senior Consultant or Consultant  




So, what will I do?

Design, build, and modernize semantic layers to enable self-service analytics, AI, and cross-platform reporting
Design and develop data-rich applications that blend standard software (Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, or similar) with open-source technologies (e.g., Streamlit) 
Facilitate design and requirements sessions with business and technical teams, translating insights into actionable data models and technical solutions
Develop and optimize data models using SQL, Python, or other relevant languages
Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and stakeholders to ensure data quality, usability, and alignment with business goals
Implement best practices for data integration, governance, and analytics enablement
Contribute to the delivery of integrated analytics experiences, moving beyond traditional dashboards to deliver holistic, user-centric solutions
Stay current with emerging tools and techniques in analytics engineering, AI, and data platforms




And, what will I bring?

3–5 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field
Proficiency in SQL and/or Python; experience with semantic layer tools and analytics platforms (e.g., dbt, Looker, Power BI, Tableau, Sigma)
Strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytics solution design
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
Fluency in whiteboarding and design solutions for data mapping and user experience requirements
Exposure to or interest in AI/ML integration and modern data architectures
Excellent communication and collaboration skills




Hybrid/In office: We are hybrid but there are expectations that if your team leader requires you onsite that you are able to meet those expectations/requirements 




Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this position, the expected base salary pay range depends on your level. 

Consultant: $85,000 - $115,000  

Senior Consultant: $100,000 - $130,000

In addition, there is potential for a discretionary bonus based on individual and company performance. Actual compensation will depend upon individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and other relevant factors.




Slalom Employee Perks: 

Culture & fun!  
Lunch & learns 
Health & wellness activities 
Holiday parties  
Employee community groups 
Social clubs & activities  
Vacation (20 days prorated based on start date & wellness/sick days) 

 

Tangible perks 

Competitive compensation package 
$100 cell phone monthly reimbursement 
Registered Retirement Program (RRSP) & Employer Matching 
Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA) 
Annual “Thrive Well-Being” Gift Card 
Family planning/ Fertility Benefit 
Maternity/Parental Leave Top-Up 
Medical & Dental Benefits 
Life and AD&D Insurance 
Access to Supplementary Life and AD&D Insurance 
Access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Inkblot Therapy 
And more! 

*All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements 

 

Slalom is an inclusive, equal opportunity employer dedicated to building a diverse workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will work to reasonably accommodate applicants’ needs throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process.

Please note if you are hired at Slalom you will be required to complete a background check.
